svg.title: compose-add-comment · long · 100x30
svg.text: +Run `viewer FILE`, then press `j` and `k` to move.
1. Open a file longer than the screen
4. Press `J` and `K` on a file with three hunks
Every one of them stopped where the docs will say it stops. The only
surprise was `K` on the first hunk, which does nothing rather than
wrapping to the last one, and that matches the rest.
The screenshot in the README is from 0.5 and still shows the old title
bar. It'd be worth refreshing it in the same PR.
A few notes for whoever picks up the wrap-around follow-up:
- keep the default as it is today
- put the setting next to the other viewer settings
- make `G` and `g` respect it too, so the keys stay consistent
That's all from me on this line.
